title: Update YouTube link to new channel

requirements.summary: Update the YouTube social media link in the Footer component to point to the new channel URL
acceptanceCriteria: The YouTube icon in the Footer links to https://www.youtube.com/@sanatani-omkar07
The link opens in a new tab when clicked

file_operations.description: Update the YouTube social media link href attribute from the current URL to https://www.youtube.com/@sanatani-omkar07. Ensure the link maintains the existing target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer' attributes for proper new tab behavior and security. Maintain all existing styling and icon rendering.
